---
title: "Phylogenetic Analysis Report"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    theme: flatly
    code_folding: hide
params:
  rf_distances: NULL
  topo_summary: NULL
  concordance: NULL
  model_summary: NULL
  alignment_summary: NULL
  concat_tree: NULL
  sp_tree: NULL
  coalescent_tree: NULL
  genes: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

## Alignment Summary

```{r debug, echo=TRUE}
message("alignment_summary path: ", params$alignment_summary)
message("file exists: ", file.exists(params$alignment_summary))
message("working dir: ", getwd())
message("absolute path: ", normalizePath(params$alignment_summary, mustWork = FALSE))
```

```{r alignment}
if (!is.null(params$alignment_summary) && file.exists(params$alignment_summary)) {
  cat(readLines(params$alignment_summary), sep = "\n")
} else {
  cat("Alignment summary file not found:", params$alignment_summary)
}
```
